recognize_zh: 印片（imprint smear）中滿布小而圓、核深染、細胞質極少的成熟淋巴球，其間夾雜少數較大、染色質較鬆散、細胞質較多的前淋巴球（prolymphocytes），另有散在的分葉核中性球作為大小對照。
features: Dense population of small mature lymphocytes with round, condensed nuclei and scant cytoplasm
Interspersed larger cells with more open chromatin and moderate cytoplasm, consistent with prolymphocytes
Scattered band and segmented neutrophils serving as size references
Cellular imprint with interspersed fat spaces
Strong magenta color cast and limited focus obscure nucleoli and fine chromatin detail
describe_en: Imprint smear shows a hypercellular preparation dominated by small mature-appearing lymphocytes with round, dense nuclei and scant cytoplasm. A minority of larger lymphoid cells with more open chromatin and moderate cytoplasm, consistent with prolymphocytes, are interspersed, together with scattered band and segmented neutrophils. The magenta color cast and image focus limit evaluation of nucleoli and chromatin pattern. Findings are consistent with a small B-cell lymphoproliferative disorder such as chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma; immunophenotyping is required for classification.

ddx.vs: MCL cells tend to have irregular notched nuclei and are cyclin D1 and SOX11 positive, requiring immunostains or FISH for t(11;14) to separate from CLL.
Myelocytes and metamyelocytes have granular cytoplasm and indented nuclei, whereas the dominant cells here are agranular lymphocytes with scant cytoplasm.
LPL shows a spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P.
